sources.label: Gate announcement: GUSD minting with USD1 (2026-07-07; re-opened 2026-07-28)

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28 of Gate.com product and minting pages (Gate GUSD, not Gemini Dollar): product page states GUSD is a principal-protected earn product with returns from Gate ecosystem revenue, treasury RWAs, and high-quality stablecoin-backed yield assets, and separately markets U.S. Treasuries / RWA backing plus USDC reserves in dollars and short-term Treasuries; minting page repeats ecosystem revenue + Treasury RWAs + stablecoin yield assets and describes the product as backed by tokenized treasury bills and stablecoins. Gate announcement (2026-07-07) uses the same three-source yield language. CoinGecko independently describes GUSD as a Gate yield-bearing investment certificate backed by U.S. Treasury / RWA (not a payment stablecoin). No page publishes token-specific composition weights, named instrument list, named GUSD-specific custodian, or a current reserve attestation; accepted subscription assets (USDT/USDC/USD1) are minting inputs, not reserve weights. Composition remains one explicit mixed basket with 100% known-unknown allocation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gate GUSD product, minting, and announcement disclosures; CoinGecko corroboration of RWA/Treasury investment-certificate design
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Gate does not publish current weights or instrument identities for Treasury/RWA products, stablecoin reserves or yield assets, ecosystem revenue, or the custody providers supporting the product.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Gate-managed Treasury/RWA, stablecoin-reserve, and ecosystem-yield basket (allocation undisclosed)
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The issuer names broad reserve and yield sources but does not publish a current composition or a defensible split; accepted subscription tokens are not treated as reserve dependencies.

providers.name: Gate ecosystem and undisclosed RWA custodians

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Gate does not identify the legal reserve vehicle, custody providers, provider shares, segregation model, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms for GUSD backing. Launch-era materials only promised gradual disclosure of reserve proofs and custodian cooperation; no GUSD-specific custody schedule was located on re-open 2026-07-28.
